description: Property Inspection Interview guides a bilingual, observation-first pre-purchase house interview. It records interview progress in an in-memory state token, can read a selected building profile from Estonia's Building Register after consent, and prepares a conservative, evidence-linked analysis for expert review. From the completed card, a user can explicitly transfer the interview details and all attached reduced photo previews, up to 40, to their signed-in Property Intelligence Hub.

defaultPrompt: Start a guided pre-purchase home inspection interview for a detached house.
Help me record visible roof, façade, basement, and building-system observations without diagnosing problems.
Create a conservative, evidence-linked summary of my completed inspection and list follow-up questions for the seller.
